item.title: The Hardest Online Course I Ever Took
item.description: A personal memoir on conquering the Udacity Self-Driving Car Engineer Nanodegree (SDCND) from scratch without a Computer Science degree—covering MIT DeepTraffic, sensor fusion in C++, and master's-level engineering rigor.
